details: Bitcoin (BTC) kicked off October with strong upward momentum, jumping over 2.2% to trade around $86,150. This rally is fueled by a major bank, Citi, raising its 12-month Bitcoin price target from $82,000 to $113,000, citing increased crypto activity and positive spot ETF inflows.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $86K as "Uptober" Rally Begins, Citi Raises Price Target

details: Ethereum continues to dominate the tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs), accounting for $22.4 billion of the total $46.2 billion now tokenized. This significant growth highlights Ethereum's pivotal role and expanding opportunities in the DeFi sector for asset utilization on-chain.
title: Ethereum Leads Real-World Asset Tokenization with $22.4 Billion

details: MetaMask disclosed a security incident late on September 30, affecting a part of its infrastructure related to its non-custodial staking operation (formerly Consensys Staking). While no immediate threat to user wallets or funds has been found, MetaMask is precautionary exiting affected validators from the Lido protocol.
title: MetaMask Reports Security Incident, Exits Staking Validators

details: Illinois has agreed to postpone the implementation of a 0.2% tax on crypto buys, sales, and transfers, including non-profit trades, until July 1, 2027. This delay comes amidst ongoing lawsuits from industry groups challenging the tax.
title: Illinois Postpones Crypto Transaction Tax Until Mid-2027

details: SMBC Nikko Securities, Nethermind, Uniswap Labs, Base, and Nyx Foundation have partnered to develop a Japan-focused DeFi Gateway. Targeted for completion by mid-2027, the project aims to provide Japanese investors with a controlled route into decentralized finance using Uniswap v4 hooks for AML/CFT and investor protection.
title: Japan's SMBC Nikko Collaborates with Uniswap, Base on Regulated DeFi Gateway

details: The SEC has released proposed rules regarding the custody of crypto assets held by investment advisers and funds. The proposal allows investment advisers and funds to self-custody crypto assets if no permitted custodian is available, provided they implement stringent safeguarding systems, including private key management and multi-person transaction approvals.
title: SEC Proposes New Crypto Custody Rules for Investment Advisers

details: The NEAR Intents protocol was exploited for approximately $3.8 million due to a bug in the Omni deposit and withdrawal infrastructure. Services were temporarily paused, the bug was patched, and the NEAR team has pledged full reimbursement for the lost funds.
title: NEAR Intents Suffers $3.8 Million Exploit

details: Social sentiment for Ethereum (ETH) and XRP has fallen to multi-month lows as October begins, with bullish-to-bearish ratios at 0.89 for ETH (lowest since June 7) and 0.67 for XRP (weakest since August 17). This contrasts with Bitcoin's more positive sentiment.
title: Ethereum and XRP Sentiment Hit Multi-Month Lows Despite BTC Uptick
